description: Convert between JSON and XML. Operations: "to-xml" — Convert JSON to XML.; "to-json" — Convert XML to JSON.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: to-xml: JSON to convert to XML to-json: XML to convert to JSON

operation.description: to-xml — Convert JSON to XML. to-json — Convert XML to JSON.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

indent.description: Indent width in spaces. Used by: to-xml.

rootName.description: Root element name. Used by: to-xml.

name: json-xml
title: JSON to XML Converter
